title: NVIDIA凭借Vera Rubin平台横扫MLPerf培训与端点评测
originalTitle: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
summary: NVIDIA Vera Rubin平台在MLPerf Training v6.1和Endpoints基准测试中表现领先，吞吐量每瓦特提升超10倍，并实现大规模GPU集群97%效率。
reason: 原文对比了Vera Rubin与GB300系统在MLPerf Training和Endpoints中的表现，展示了NVIDIA在端侧计算和大规模集群优化上的突破
author: Shruti Koparkar
